info.title: Gym Management API
info.description:
Comprehensive gym management platform API. Manages user registration, authentication, subscriptions, payments, coach/member administration, and audit logging.

## Authentication
All protected endpoints require a `Bearer <accessToken>` token in the `Authorization` header.

## Role Hierarchy
- **BASIC** — Default role after signup (unverified user).
- **MEMBER** — Granted upon payment approval; can access subscription status, plans, and contact info.
- **ADMIN** — Coach account; can manage members, view payments, and approve/reject payment requests.
- **SUPER_ADMIN** — Platform administrator; full access to coach CRUD, audit logs, and deleted accounts. Implicitly allowed wherever `ADMIN` is required.

## Rate Limiting
- **Signup**: 10 requests per 15-minute window per IP.
- **Forgot Password**: 5 requests per 15-minute window per IP.
- **Delete Account**: 5 requests per 15-minute window per IP.
- **Login**: Brute-force protection — account locked after repeated failures.

## CORS
Allowed origins are configured via `CORS_ORIGINS` (comma-separated). In production the list is mandatory; in development `localhost:3000` and `127.0.0.1:3000` are always allowed.

Changes a member's plan duration. The new duration must be one of 1, 3, 6, or 12 months.

bearerAuth.description: JSON Web Token obtained from `POST /auth/login`. Include as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Access tokens expire after 24 hours.

details.description: Optional additional error context (e.g. retryAfterMs for rate limits, or field-level validation details)

retryAfterMs.description: Milliseconds until the rate limit window resets

oneOf.description: Field-level validation errors or other context

refreshToken.description: JWT refresh token for obtaining new access tokens

sessionExpiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the session expires
ISO 8601 timestamp of when the session expires

nickname.description: New nickname (trimmed, max 50 characters). Only this field is accepted; unknown keys are rejected.

isVerified.description: Whether the email has been verified

UserProfile.description: Returned from profile update. Same shape as User.

Role.description: User role. Lifecycle: BASIC (default) -> MEMBER (on payment approval) -> BASIC (on expiry/cancel). ADMIN = coach, SUPER_ADMIN = manages coaches.

CoachProfile.description: Public-facing coach profile returned by GET /coaches/:coachNumber

Coach.description: Full coach record returned by admin endpoints

SubscriptionConfirmation.description: Data returned after confirming a subscription selection, to be forwarded to payment

mode.description: Whether this is a new subscription or an extension

SubscriptionStatus.description: Current subscription status for the authenticated member

contactUsAccess.description: Whether the member can access contact information

subscription.description: Active subscription details, or null if no active subscription

remainingDays.description: Number of days until subscription expires

expiringSoon.description: Whether the subscription is expiring soon

reference.description: Payment reference number (letters, digits, dashes, underscores only)

amount.description: Payment amount (positive number, in the currency unit)

PaymentSubmission.description: Summary of a submitted payment request

isExtension.description: Whether this is an extension payment

PublicPayment.description: Public payment request record as returned by toPublicPayment (used in GET /payments and GET /admin/payments)

coach.description: Coach who owns this payment request

user.description: User who submitted the payment request

days.description: Number of days to reduce the subscription by (max 3 years)

MemberExtendAction.description: Result of a member extend or change-plan action

MemberReduceAction.description: Result of a member reduce action

ended.description: Whether the subscription was ended (reduced to zero or below)

expiresAt.description: New expiry date, or null if subscription ended

Member.description: Member record in the coach's member list

remainingDays.description: Number of days until subscription expires

details.description: Additional context as a JSON object or raw string

originalId.description: The original user ID before deletion

userId.description: ID of an existing ADMIN user to promote into a coach profile

ContactInfo.description: Gym contact information (available to active MEMBERS only)
